Name: Abrah's Halloween Recipes
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
🎃 Abrah’s Recipes Halloween Edition 🎀✨ A dreamy witchy food collection for your Stardew Valley kitchen ✨
Adds five brand new spooky cute recipes to your game all hand crafted in pixel perfection to fit the cozy magical atmosphere of Stardew Valley.
[line]🦇 1. Bat Pasta
[b]Ingredients:[/b] Squid Ink ×1 Wheat Flour ×1 Bat Wing ×1 Egg ×1
[b]Sell Price:[/b] 450g
[b]Edibility:[/b] 75
[b]Description:[/b] A dark and spooky pasta dish shaped like tiny bats perfect for a midnight feast

[line]🌙 2. Moonlight Éclair
[b]Ingredients:[/b] Milk ×1 Sugar ×1 Chocolate Cake ×1 Blueberry ×1
[b]Sell Price:[/b] 420g
[b]Edibility:[/b] 75
[b]Description:[/b] A creamy celestial éclair glowing faintly under the moonlight

[line]🎃 3. Pumpkin Spice Latte
[b]Ingredients:[/b] Pumpkin ×1 Sugar ×1 Coffee ×1
[b]Sell Price:[/b] 350g
[b]Edibility:[/b] 65
[b]Description:[/b] A warm autumn classic with a sweet witchy twist best enjoyed near the fireplace

[line]💜 4. Dusk Cake
[b]Ingredients:[/b] Egg ×1 Sugar ×1 Flour ×1 Starfruit ×1
[b]Sell Price:[/b] 500g
[b]Edibility:[/b] 90
[b]Description:[/b] A luxurious twilight dessert that glows softly as night falls

[line]💚 5. Slime Truffles
[b]Ingredients:[/b] Slime ×1 Wheat Flour ×1 Sugar ×1
[b]Sell Price:[/b] 350g
[b]Edibility:[/b] 65
[b]Description:[/b] Squishy shiny and surprisingly sweet a treat born from mischief and magic

[line]🧙‍♀️ Installation Guide[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the ZIP file

[*]Inside you will find five separate folders one for each recipe

[*]Do not mix or merge them each one is a standalone Content Patcher mod

[*]Place all folders inside your stardew valley mods folder

[*]Launch the game with SMAPI installed

[/list]You can pick the recipe folder you want from the zip and extract it to the mods folder and delete the rest or you can put all of it if you want!
[line][b]🪄 Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] latest version
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]latest version
